title: Up refuses a base branch in Graphyard's namespace and commits without a host git identity
description: On a scratch repository with HOME pointing at an empty git config, up refuses --base-branch graphyard and graphyard/x before any action runs naming the branch namespace, onboarding commits are authored by Graphyard's own identity, and a failing step's event and printed error carry the command's stderr.

steps.name: up preflight branch namespace, commit identity and step stderr
